newsitem.title: USA: A. Schulman comfortable with EPS estimates.
newsitem.headline: A. Schulman comfortable with EPS estimates.

text.p: A. Schulman Inc said that analysts' estimates of $0.32 per share for the first quarter ended November 30 "appear reasonable."
The plastic compounds and resins supplier said it is also comfortable with analysts' earnings estimates of $1.40 per share for the fiscal year.
The company said it expects gains in its business in both Europe and North America during fiscal 1997.
The company said in a statement that it is also "looking at businesses in southern Europe and a former Eastern Bloc nation as possible acquisition candidates."
In a release, the company said its goal for fiscal 1997 is a 25 percent increase in profits.
The more long-term goals are net profit of six percent on revenues and 15 percent return on equity.
